name: An INPS pension in Germany (IT, taxedIn source)
workings: Germany taxes the DRV pension only: taxable income 14,771.2128 (drv-pension-tax-2030); the contributions on the INPS pension belong to income exempt in Germany, so they aren't deducted (verify)
Progression clause: the INPS pension as German law counts it, 86% × 12,000 = 10,320.00 (the €102 is already used)
Health and care on the INPS pension are still due in Germany, which provides the cover
Italy taxes the INPS pension as a non-resident's (in the planner, ItalyTaxSystem.prepareNonResident); Germany exempts it, so it credits none of that tax
